description: Update a campaign's name, geography, cadence, intro override, products, or status. products (if given) is the full replacement set (1-5, same union as create_email_campaign). Any geography field replaces the campaign's whole state selection. Set status 'active' to start sending (requires branding display_name + business_address) or 'paused' to stop. Provide exactly one of state_code, state_codes, or region.

products.description: Full replacement product set (1-5, no duplicates); same shapes as create_email_campaign.

region.description: Named region preset (e.g. east_coast); expands server-side to its member states.

state_code.description: Legacy single 2-letter US state code. Prefer state_codes or region.

state_codes.description: 2-letter US state codes (up to 25) — best rates are ranked ACROSS all of them, not per state.

name: update_email_campaign

outputSchema.description: The campaign after the patch. Activating a campaign requires a display name and business address on the org branding.

products.description: Parsed list of products the email covers.

state_code.description: Legacy scalar state — first entry of state_codes.

state_codes.description: Full list of covered state codes.
